preconditions.expression: len(hex_color) == 7 and hex_color[0] == '#' and all(c in '0123456789ABCDEFabcdef' for c in hex_color[1:])
preconditions.description: The input string must be a valid 7-character hexadecimal color code starting with '#', with all subsequent characters being valid hex digits (case-insensitive).

postconditions.description: The returned dictionary must contain the red, green, and blue components extracted from the hexadecimal string, where each component is an integer between 0 and 255, derived from the corresponding two-character segments of the input string.
